source.rationale: Fourth independent instance of the same completeness-gap shape (Future Product Opportunities #11), fourth unrelated domain (API client auth), to further test domain-generality now that 024 provides a third data point. Deliberately keeps the exact same STRUCTURE (code example call site + separate parameter bullet, one new optional parameter) as 001/006/024 so any divergence in outcome is attributable to domain content, not case design.

human_fixed_doc_section:
```python
request("GET", "https://api.example.com/items", auth_token="...")
```

* `method` -- HTTP method to use.
* `url` -- target URL.
* `headers` -- optional dict of extra headers to send.
* `auth_token` -- optional bearer token, sent as an `Authorization` header if provided.
